```text
1	# agent-history-hygiene
2	
3	Keep coding-agent chat transcripts and plan files committed alongside
4	the feature diff they produced, without leaking `.env` contents or API
5	keys into git history.
6	
7	| Surface | Question it answers |
8	|---|---|
9	| `find-session.sh` | "Which transcript / plan file is *my* current session?" |
10	| `stage-agent-artifacts.sh` | "Which agent files belong in the next commit?" |
11	| `agent-commit-metadata.sh` | "Which harness/model and artifact trailers belong in it?" |
12	| `bootstrap-project.sh` | "How do I get pre-commit + gitleaks + redactor into a new repo?" |
13	| `scan-staged.sh` | "Is there a leaked secret in what I'm about to commit?" |
14	| `probe-specstory-redaction.py` | "What does SpecStory already redact, so we don't redo it?" |
15	| `references/remediation.md` | "I already pushed a secret — now what?" |
16	
17	The skill exists to stop three common failure modes:
18	
19	1. Agents silently **dropping** `.specstory/history/*.md` and
20	   `.claude/plans/*.md` from commits because they look like generated
21	   artifacts.
22	2. Accidental `.env` echoes inside chat transcripts that then get
23	   committed and pushed.
24	3. Reflexive `git push --force` after a leak — which doesn't actually
25	   revoke the credential and often destroys teammate work.
26	
27	## When the skill triggers
28	
29	- "Commit my chat" / "save the specstory session" / "stage the plan
30	  file" / "把 plan 跟 specstory 一起 commit 進去".
31	- Untracked `.specstory/history/*.md` or `.claude/plans/*.md` during a
32	  `git status`.
33	- "Scrub this transcript" / "redact my key" / "gitleaks flagged my
34	  chat history".
35	- "Set up pre-commit for this repo" / "bootstrap secret scanning".
36	- "I pushed a `.env`" / "a secret went to main" — the skill steers to
37	  the rotate-first runbook instead of a history rewrite.
38	
39	## Structure
40	
41	```
42	skills/local/agent-history-hygiene/
43	├── SKILL.md                                  # agent-facing workflow and invariants
44	├── scripts/
45	│   ├── find-session.sh                       # locate current SpecStory + Claude session
46	│   ├── stage-agent-artifacts.sh              # git-add the right artifacts
47	│   ├── agent-commit-metadata.sh               # derive staged provenance trailers
48	│   ├── bootstrap-project.sh                  # install pre-commit + gitleaks, wire the redactor
49	│   ├── probe-specstory-redaction.py          # measure SpecStory's own redaction coverage
50	│   └── scan-staged.sh                        # gitleaks wrapper with agent-friendly exit codes
51	├── references/
52	│   ├── transcript-session-discovery.md       # SpecStory / Claude session layouts
53	│   ├── pre-commit-redaction-stack.md         # layered defense design
54	│   ├── specstory-native-redaction.md         # what upstream redacts, measured
55	│   └── remediation.md                        # rotate-first leak runbook
56	└── assets/
57	    ├── artifact-dirs.txt                     # configurable list of agent artifact dirs
58	    ├── pre-commit-config.yaml.template
59	    ├── gitleaks.toml.template
60	    └── redact_secrets.py                     # run in place from the installed skill
61	```
62	
63	## Integration with chezmoi
64	
65	The skill sits on top of the user's existing chezmoi infrastructure
66	(if present):
67	
68	- `~/.config/git/hooks/pre-commit` (global `core.hooksPath`) runs the
69	  repo-level `.pre-commit-config.yaml` this skill installs.
70	- `~/.local/share/chezmoi/scripts/redact_secrets.py` was the original
71	  upstream. `assets/redact_secrets.py` is now the source of truth and reaches
72	  consuming repos as a **pinned pre-commit hook** published from this repo's
73	  root `.pre-commit-hooks.yaml` — no vendored copy to drift.
74	  `bootstrap-project.sh --from-chezmoi` still symlinks the chezmoi
75	  `.pre-commit-config.yaml` / `.gitleaks.toml` for repos that prefer it.
76	- `~/.local/share/chezmoi/.gitleaks.toml` shares rule IDs with the
77	  skill's `gitleaks.toml.template` so `.gitleaksignore` / allowlist
78	  tweaks stay portable across repos.
79	
80	For repos without chezmoi, `bootstrap-project.sh` produces a
81	self-contained stack. The redactor is **not** copied into the repo: the
82	generated `.pre-commit-config.yaml` references the hook by tag, so
83	`pre-commit autoupdate` ships fixes everywhere and the script path never
84	depends on where `npx skills` happened to install the skill.
85	
86	```yaml
87	- repo: https://github.com/daviddwlee84/agent-skills
88	  rev: ahh-v1.1.0
89	  hooks:
90	    - id: redact-agent-secrets
91	```
92	
93	`bootstrap-project.sh --migrate` converts a repo off the old vendored
94	`scripts/redact_secrets.py` layout.
95	
96	`--install-hook` refuses to run when `core.hooksPath` redirects Git away from
97	`.git/hooks/`. It exits before writing bootstrap files and tells the user to
98	integrate the hook into the configured directory or unset the override for that
99	repo; the skill never edits a global hook directory on the user's behalf.
100	
101	## Default workflow: commit feature + chat together
102	
103	```bash
104	# 1. Make sure the agent knows which session is "ours".
105	bash skills/local/agent-history-hygiene/scripts/find-session.sh
106	
107	# 2. Stage code, then auto-add agent artifacts.
108	git add path/to/feature.ts
109	bash skills/local/agent-history-hygiene/scripts/stage-agent-artifacts.sh
110	
111	# 3. Generate the canonical final trailer block from staged artifacts.
112	bash skills/local/agent-history-hygiene/scripts/agent-commit-metadata.sh
113	
114	# 4. Scan secrets and validate the complete English message.
115	bash skills/local/agent-history-hygiene/scripts/scan-staged.sh
116	bash skills/local/git-workflow/scripts/check-commit-msg.sh \
117	  --agentic --staged --file /path/to/commit-message.txt
118	
119	# 5. Commit. Pre-commit re-runs redact + gitleaks as a catch-all.
120	git commit -F /path/to/commit-message.txt
121	```
122	
123	The metadata helper reads staged blobs, not concurrently-changing working
124	files. It emits deduplicated `AI-Assisted-By: Harness (model)`,
125	`Agent-Transcript`, and conditional `Agent-Plan` trailers. Pass explicit
126	`--harness` + `--model` only when a transcript cannot prove that identity.
127	
128	## SpecStory native redaction (v2.4.0+)
129	
130	SpecStory ships its own secret redaction now, so this skill is no longer the
131	first line of defense for `.specstory/history/`.
132	
133	| Ref | What |
134	|---|---|
135	| [PR #235](https://github.com/specstoryai/getspecstory/pull/235) | `feat(redaction): automatically redact secrets from saved markdown history` — community PR by [@warnes](https://github.com/warnes), merged 2026-07-20 |
136	| [PR #253](https://github.com/specstoryai/getspecstory/pull/253) | A `gofmt` CI-fix fork of #235; closed in favor of #235 |
137	| **v2.4.0** (2026-07-20) | Shipped **on by default**, via the [Betterleaks](https://github.com/betterleaks/betterleaks) ruleset, covering local markdown **and** cloud sync |
138	| [#274](https://github.com/specstoryai/getspecstory/issues/274) (open) | Adjacent leak vector — `specstory watch` exposes the cloud auth token in its process command line |
139	
140	The merged code is not the PR's: the maintainer swapped its 11 inline regexes
141	for Betterleaks, and the PR's `extra_patterns` (custom regexes) did not survive
142	that rewrite. `[redaction] enabled` in `.specstory/cli/config.toml` — or
143	`--no-redact-secrets` — is the only knob.
144	
145	### Measured coverage
146	
147	`scripts/probe-specstory-redaction.py` synthesizes a Claude Code session,
148	renders it twice through `specstory sync --print` (with and without
149	`--no-redact-secrets`), and diffs per secret class. Against specstory 2.9.0,
150	over 54 class/context pairs:
151	
152	| Caught by | Pairs | Examples |
153	|---|---:|---|
154	| SpecStory | 36 | Anthropic, OpenAI, GitHub PAT/OAuth/Actions, GitLab, Google, Groq, Slack, Stripe, Supabase, Linear, PEM blocks, `.env` dumps |
155	| **Ours only** | 15 | Cursor, Tailscale, Discord/Zapier/Make webhooks — plus HuggingFace, Notion, WakaTime, OpenAI project keys **in prose** |
156	| Nobody | 3 | `AKIA…` access key IDs; Telegram bot tokens in prose |
157	
158	The structural finding: Betterleaks catches several classes only in
159	`KEY=value` form, via an entropy-based `generic-api-key` rule. The same token
160	in a sentence — which is how a tool transcript actually prints one — sails
161	through. Our prefix-anchored rules don't care about surrounding syntax.
162	
163	### How the two layers stay out of each other's way
164	
165	Both write the same sentinel, `[REDACTED:<rule-id>]` (SpecStory's binary
166	carries the format string `[REDACTED:%s]`), and `.gitleaks.toml` allowlists
167	that shape. A transcript SpecStory already cleaned passes through the hook
168	untouched — no "files were modified by this hook", no re-`git add`, no second
169	commit.
170	
171	The redactor writes `[REDACTED:<rule-id>]` instead of `sk-abc...xyz`
172	truncations, and PEM blocks become `[REDACTED:private-key]` — the exact label
173	SpecStory uses. The truncated form still appears in the console report, where a
174	fingerprint helps identify which credential to rotate. `--legacy` writes the
175	pre-2.4.0 placeholders instead; it changes only the bytes written, never what
176	is detected.
177	
178	(The related rule that a bare `PRIVATE KEY` *mention* is not key material —
179	`detect-private-key` greps for `BEGIN … PRIVATE KEY` headers — is enforced
180	separately by the redactor's header-scoped matching.)
181	
182	## Post-leak discipline
183	
184	`scan-staged.sh` exit codes branch on leak state (0 clean, 10 redacted,
185	20 leaks, 30 no gitleaks). When a leak slips through:
186	
187	1. **Rotate at the provider.** The only act that revokes the
188	   credential. Links in `references/remediation.md` §1.
189	2. **Assess blast radius.** Local/unpushed? Feature branch? Main?
190	3. **Scrub only if cheap.** Amend or `reset --soft` on unpushed commits;
191	   `git filter-repo` + force-with-lease on feature branches; **never**
192	   rewrite `main`.
193	
194	The runbook explicitly forbids `git push --force` against shared
195	branches — see `references/remediation.md` §5.
196	
197	## Gotchas
198	
199	- A configured `core.hooksPath` makes `.git/hooks/prepare-commit-msg` inert.
200	  `bootstrap-project.sh --install-hook` now exits 6 instead of installing a
201	  hook that Git will never execute.
202	- Native Claude/Cursor attribution is additive. The portable minimum is the
203	  final `AI-Assisted-By` + transcript/plan block; do not invent an AI email or
204	  confuse message attribution with cryptographic signing.
205	
206	- SpecStory ≥ 2.4.0 already redacts on write — don't let the hook redo it.
207	  See [SpecStory native redaction](#specstory-native-redaction-v240) above.
208	- A bare "PRIVATE KEY" mention is not a leak; `detect-private-key` matches
209	  `BEGIN … PRIVATE KEY` only. Redacting prose churned transcripts for nothing.
210	- Claude Code `plansDirectory` project-level is sometimes ignored
211	  ([issue #19537](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/19537));
212	  set at the user level (`~/.claude/settings.json`) as the default.
213	- `gitleaks protect` is deprecated since v8.19.0 — use `gitleaks git
214	  --staged`. The skill uses the modern syntax everywhere.
215	- `pre-commit install` is per-clone — each teammate (and CI) must run
216	  it for hooks to fire.
217	- Global `core.hooksPath` runs the repo's `.pre-commit-config.yaml`
218	  only if it exists; a bare repo is unprotected until bootstrap.
219	
220	## See also
221	
222	- [Source](https://github.com/daviddwlee84/agent-skills/tree/main/skills/local/agent-history-hygiene)
223	- [`project-knowledge-harness`](project-knowledge-harness.md) —
224	  complementary memory harness that references `.claude/plans/` as
225	  ephemeral scratchpads. This skill closes the loop by making sure
226	  those scratchpads actually land in git.
227

59	    ├── artifact-dirs.txt                     # 可設定的 agent artifact 目錄清單
60	    ├── pre-commit-config.yaml.template
61	    ├── gitleaks.toml.template
62	    └── redact_secrets.py                     # 直接在安裝好的 skill 原地執行
63	```
64	
65	## 與 chezmoi 的整合
66	
67	這個 skill 疊在使用者既有的 chezmoi 基礎設施之上（如有）：
68	
69	- `~/.config/git/hooks/pre-commit`（全域 `core.hooksPath`）跑這個 skill
70	  在 repo 層級裝的 `.pre-commit-config.yaml`。
71	- `~/.local/share/chezmoi/scripts/redact_secrets.py` 原本是 upstream。
72	  現在 `assets/redact_secrets.py` 是 source of truth，並透過本 repo 根目錄的
73	  `.pre-commit-hooks.yaml` 以**釘選版本的 pre-commit hook** 形式送到下游 repo
74	  —— 沒有會走味的 vendored 副本。偏好 chezmoi 版本的 repo 仍可用
75	  `bootstrap-project.sh --from-chezmoi` symlink `.pre-commit-config.yaml` /
76	  `.gitleaks.toml`。
77	- `~/.local/share/chezmoi/.gitleaks.toml` 跟 skill 的
78	  `gitleaks.toml.template` 共用 rule ID，這樣 `.gitleaksignore` /
79	  allowlist 微調可在 repo 間 portable。
80	
81	對沒有 chezmoi 的 repo，`bootstrap-project.sh` 產生自包含的 stack。
82	redactor **不會**被複製進 repo：產生的 `.pre-commit-config.yaml` 以 tag
83	引用該 hook，所以 `pre-commit autoupdate` 就能把修正送到每個 repo，
84	而且 script 路徑完全不依賴 `npx skills` 把 skill 裝在哪裡。
85	
86	```yaml
87	- repo: https://github.com/daviddwlee84/agent-skills
88	  rev: ahh-v1.1.0
89	  hooks:
90	    - id: redact-agent-secrets
91	```
92	
93	舊的 vendored `scripts/redact_secrets.py` 佈局可用
94	`bootstrap-project.sh --migrate` 轉換過來。
95	
96	若 `core.hooksPath` 把 Git hook 導向 `.git/hooks/` 以外的位置，
97	`--install-hook` 會在寫入 bootstrap 檔案前拒絕執行，並提示把整合加入設定中的
98	hook directory，或只對該 repo 取消 override。Skill 不會自行修改 global hook。
99	
100	## 預設工作流程：把功能跟對話一起 commit
101	
102	```bash
103	# 1. 確保 agent 知道哪一個 session 是「我們的」。
104	bash skills/local/agent-history-hygiene/scripts/find-session.sh
105	
106	# 2. Stage code，再自動 add agent artifact。
107	git add path/to/feature.ts
108	bash skills/local/agent-history-hygiene/scripts/stage-agent-artifacts.sh
109	
110	# 3. 從 staged artifacts 產生 canonical final trailer block。
111	bash skills/local/agent-history-hygiene/scripts/agent-commit-metadata.sh
112	
113	# 4. 掃描 secret，再驗證完整英文 commit message。
114	bash skills/local/agent-history-hygiene/scripts/scan-staged.sh
115	bash skills/local/git-workflow/scripts/check-commit-msg.sh \
116	  --agentic --staged --file /path/to/commit-message.txt
117	
118	# 5. Commit。Pre-commit 會把 redact + gitleaks 當成 catch-all 再跑一次。
119	git commit -F /path/to/commit-message.txt
120	```
121	
122	Metadata helper 讀 staged blob，而不是仍可能被背景程序修改的 working file。
123	它輸出去重後的 `AI-Assisted-By: Harness (model)`、`Agent-Transcript` 與有 plan
124	時的 `Agent-Plan`。只有 transcript 無法證明 identity 時，才同時傳入
125	`--harness` 與 `--model`。
126	
127	## SpecStory 原生 redaction（v2.4.0+）
128	
129	SpecStory 現在自己就會 redact secret，所以這個 skill 對
130	`.specstory/history/` 已經不是第一道防線了。
131	
132	| 出處 | 內容 |
133	|---|---|
134	| [PR #235](https://github.com/specstoryai/getspecstory/pull/235) | `feat(redaction): automatically redact secrets from saved markdown history` —— 社群貢獻者 [@warnes](https://github.com/warnes) 提出，2026-07-20 merged |
135	| [PR #253](https://github.com/specstoryai/getspecstory/pull/253) | #235 的 `gofmt` CI 修正分支；最後 close 掉走 #235 |
136	| **v2.4.0**（2026-07-20） | 正式釋出，**預設開啟**，改用 [Betterleaks](https://github.com/betterleaks/betterleaks) ruleset，且涵蓋本地 markdown **與** cloud sync |
137	| [#274](https://github.com/specstoryai/getspecstory/issues/274)（open） | 相關的另一個洩漏面向 —— `specstory watch` 把 cloud auth token 放進 process command line |
138	
139	實際 merge 的程式碼跟 PR 不同：維護者把 PR 裡 11 條 inline regex 換成
140	Betterleaks，而 PR 的 `extra_patterns`（自訂 regex）沒有在這次改寫中存活。
141	`.specstory/cli/config.toml` 的 `[redaction] enabled`（或 `--no-redact-secrets`）
142	是唯一的開關。
143	
144	### 實測覆蓋率
145	
146	`scripts/probe-specstory-redaction.py` 會合成一個 Claude Code session，
147	用 `specstory sync --print` 跑兩次（有 / 無 `--no-redact-secrets`），
148	再逐個 secret class 比對。對 specstory 2.9.0、共 54 組 class/context：
149	
150	| 由誰攔下 | 組數 | 例子 |
151	|---|---:|---|
152	| SpecStory | 36 | Anthropic、OpenAI、GitHub PAT/OAuth/Actions、GitLab、Google、Groq、Slack、Stripe、Supabase、Linear、PEM block、`.env` dump |
153	| **只有我們** | 15 | Cursor、Tailscale、Discord/Zapier/Make webhook —— 以及 HuggingFace、Notion、WakaTime、OpenAI project key 出現在**散文**中時 |
154	| 都沒攔到 | 3 | `AKIA…` access key ID；散文中的 Telegram bot token |
155	
156	結構性發現：Betterleaks 有好幾類只在 `KEY=value` 形式下、透過基於 entropy 的
157	`generic-api-key` rule 才攔得到。同一個 token 出現在句子裡 —— 而這正是工具
158	transcript 實際印出 token 的方式 —— 就會直接漏過去。我們以 prefix 錨定的
159	rule 不在乎前後語法。
160	
161	### 兩層如何避免互相打架
162	
163	兩邊都寫同一個 sentinel：`[REDACTED:<rule-id>]`（SpecStory 的 binary 帶有
164	格式字串 `[REDACTED:%s]`），而 `.gitleaks.toml` 把這個形狀加進 allowlist。
165	SpecStory 已經清理過的 transcript 會原封不動通過 hook —— 不會出現
166	「files were modified by this hook」，不用重新 `git add`，也不用再 commit 一次。
167	
168	redactor 改寫成 `[REDACTED:<rule-id>]`，不再寫 `sk-abc...xyz` 截斷形式；
169	PEM block 則變成 `[REDACTED:private-key]` —— 正好就是 SpecStory 用的標籤。
170	截斷形式仍保留在 console 報告中，那裡的指紋有助於判斷該去 rotate 哪把 key。
171	`--legacy` 會改回 2.4.0 之前的 placeholder，它只改變寫入的位元組，
172	不影響偵測到什麼。
173	
174	（另一條相關規則 —— 散文中單純提到 `PRIVATE KEY` 不算金鑰材料，
175	`detect-private-key` 找的是 `BEGIN … PRIVATE KEY` 標頭 —— 由 redactor
176	以標頭為範圍的比對獨立保證。）
177	
178	## 洩漏後的紀律 (Post-leak discipline)
179	
180	`scan-staged.sh` 的 exit code 依洩漏狀態分支 (0 clean、10 redacted、
181	20 leaks、30 沒裝 gitleaks)。當有洩漏溜過去：
182	
183	1. **在供應商端輪換 (rotate)。** 這是唯一真正撤銷 credential 的動作。
184	   連結見 `references/remediation.md` §1。
185	2. **評估爆炸半徑 (blast radius)。** 本地未 push？feature branch？main？
186	3. **只在便宜時才清洗 (scrub)。** 未 push commit 用 amend 或
187	   `reset --soft`；feature branch 用 `git filter-repo` +
188	   force-with-lease；**永遠不要**改寫 `main`。
189	
190	runbook 顯式禁止對共用 branch 做 `git push --force` —— 詳見
191	`references/remediation.md` §5。
192	
193	## Gotchas
194	
195	- 設定 `core.hooksPath` 後，`.git/hooks/prepare-commit-msg` 不會執行。
196	  `bootstrap-project.sh --install-hook` 現在會 exit 6，而不是安裝一個無效 hook。
197	- Claude/Cursor 原生 attribution 可以保留。可攜 minimum 是最後的
198	  `AI-Assisted-By` + transcript/plan block；不要虛構 AI email，也不要把 message
199	  attribution 說成 cryptographic signing。
200	
201	- SpecStory ≥ 2.4.0 寫檔時就已經 redact —— 別讓 hook 再做一次，
202	  見上面的「SpecStory 原生 redaction」。
203	- Claude Code 的 project-level `plansDirectory` 有時會被忽略
204	  ([issue #19537](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/19537))；
205	  把它設在 user-level (`~/.claude/settings.json`) 當預設。
206	- `gitleaks protect` 從 v8.19.0 起被棄用 —— 用 `gitleaks git --staged`。
207	  skill 中所有地方都用現代語法。
208	- `pre-commit install` 是 per-clone —— 每個隊友（跟 CI）都必須跑，
209	  hook 才會觸發。
210	- 全域 `core.hooksPath` 只在 repo 有 `.pre-commit-config.yaml` 時才執行；
211	  bootstrap 之前的裸 repo 是不受保護的。
212	
213	## 另見
214	
215	- [Source](https://github.com/daviddwlee84/agent-skills/tree/main/skills/local/agent-history-hygiene)
216	- [`project-knowledge-harness`](project-knowledge-harness.md) ——
217	  互補的記憶 harness，把 `.claude/plans/` 視為 ephemeral 塗鴉本。
218	  這個 skill 補上閉環，確保那些塗鴉本實際上會落到 git 裡。
219
```

```sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# find-session.sh — resolve an exact SpecStory / Claude Code session for a git checkout.
#
# Bash 3.2 compatible (stock macOS).

set -euo pipefail

usage() {
  cat <<'EOF'
Usage: find-session.sh (--session-id UUID | --specstory-path PATH | --newest) [OPTIONS]

Resolve agent session files for the current git checkout. Exact selectors are
required unless the caller explicitly opts into the compatibility heuristic.
Relative paths are resolved from the git root, not the invocation directory.

Selectors:
  --session-id UUID       Select the exact Claude Code session UUID. When
                          SpecStory output is requested, its header must match.
  --specstory-path PATH   Select one exact .specstory/history/*.md file and
                          derive/verify its Claude Code session UUID.
  --newest                Explicitly use independent newest-file heuristics.
                          Cannot be combined with exact selectors.

Options:
  --format VALUE          specstory, claude, or both (default: both).
  --json                  Emit one JSON object instead of TSV.
  --quiet                 Suppress stderr diagnostics; structured stdout remains.
  --help, -h              Show this help and exit.

TSV output keys:
  status                  resolved | not_found | ambiguous | mismatch | error
  confidence              exact | heuristic | none
  source                  session-id | specstory-path | session-id+specstory-path | newest
  specstory_path          absolute path or empty
  claude_session_uuid     UUID or empty
  claude_jsonl_path       absolute path or empty
  candidate               repeated absolute candidate path (only when relevant)

Exit codes:
  0  requested artifacts resolved
  1  invalid arguments
  2  not inside a git repository
  3  requested artifact not found
  4  exact selector is ambiguous; candidates are reported
  5  selected path/header/JSONL identity failed validation
EOF
}

QUIET=0
log()  { [ "$QUIET" = "1" ] || printf '%s\n' "$*" >&2; }
die()  { printf 'error: %s\n' "$1" >&2; exit "${2:-1}"; }

FORMAT="both"
OUT_JSON=0
SESSION_ID=""
SPECSTORY_INPUT=""
USE_NEWEST=0

while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
  case "$1" in
    --session-id)
      shift
      [ $# -gt 0 ] || die "--session-id needs a UUID (try --help)" 1
      SESSION_ID="$1"; shift ;;
    --session-id=*) SESSION_ID="${1#--session-id=}"; shift ;;
    --specstory-path)
      shift
      [ $# -gt 0 ] || die "--specstory-path needs a path (try --help)" 1
      SPECSTORY_INPUT="$1"; shift ;;
    --specstory-path=*) SPECSTORY_INPUT="${1#--specstory-path=}"; shift ;;
    --newest) USE_NEWEST=1; shift ;;
    --format)
      shift
      [ $# -gt 0 ] || die "--format needs specstory, claude, or both (try --help)" 1
      FORMAT="$1"; shift ;;
    --format=*) FORMAT="${1#--format=}"; shift ;;
    --json) OUT_JSON=1; shift ;;
    --quiet) QUIET=1; shift ;;
    --help|-h) usage; exit 0 ;;
    -*) die "unknown flag: $1 (try --help)" 1 ;;
    *)  die "unexpected positional arg: $1 (try --help)" 1 ;;
  esac
done

case "$FORMAT" in
  both|specstory|claude) ;;
  *) die "invalid --format: $FORMAT (expected both|specstory|claude)" 1 ;;
esac

if [ "$USE_NEWEST" = "1" ] && { [ -n "$SESSION_ID" ] || [ -n "$SPECSTORY_INPUT" ]; }; then
  die "--newest cannot be combined with --session-id or --specstory-path" 1
fi
if [ "$USE_NEWEST" = "0" ] && [ -z "$SESSION_ID" ] && [ -z "$SPECSTORY_INPUT" ]; then
  die "exact selection requires --session-id or --specstory-path (use --newest only for the compatibility heuristic)" 1
fi
if [ -n "$SESSION_ID" ] && ! printf '%s\n' "$SESSION_ID" | grep -Eq '^[0-9A-Fa-f]{8}-[0-9A-Fa-f]{4}-[0-9A-Fa-f]{4}-[0-9A-Fa-f]{4}-[0-9A-Fa-f]{12}$'; then
  die "invalid --session-id: expected a canonical UUID, received '$SESSION_ID'" 1
fi

STATUS="error"
CONFIDENCE="none"
SOURCE=""
SPECSTORY_PATH=""
CLAUDE_JSONL=""
CLAUDE_UUID="$SESSION_ID"
CANDIDATES=()

if [ "$USE_NEWEST" = "1" ]; then
  SOURCE="newest"
elif [ -n "$SESSION_ID" ] && [ -n "$SPECSTORY_INPUT" ]; then
  SOURCE="session-id+specstory-path"
elif [ -n "$SESSION_ID" ]; then
  SOURCE="session-id"
else
  SOURCE="specstory-path"
fi

json_escape() {
  printf '%s' "$1" | sed 's/\\/\\\\/g; s/"/\\"/g'
}

emit_result() {
  local candidate first
  if [ "$OUT_JSON" = "1" ]; then
    printf '{"status":"%s","confidence":"%s","source":"%s"' \
      "$(json_escape "$STATUS")" "$(json_escape "$CONFIDENCE")" "$(json_escape "$SOURCE")"
    printf ',"specstory_path":"%s"' "$(json_escape "$SPECSTORY_PATH")"
    printf ',"claude_session_uuid":"%s"' "$(json_escape "$CLAUDE_UUID")"
    printf ',"claude_jsonl_path":"%s","candidates":[' "$(json_escape "$CLAUDE_JSONL")"
    first=1
    for candidate in "${CANDIDATES[@]:-}"; do
      [ -n "$candidate" ] || continue
      [ "$first" = "1" ] || printf ','
      printf '"%s"' "$(json_escape "$candidate")"
      first=0
    done
    printf ']}\n'
  else
    printf 'status\t%s\n' "$STATUS"
    printf 'confidence\t%s\n' "$CONFIDENCE"
    printf 'source\t%s\n' "$SOURCE"
    printf 'specstory_path\t%s\n' "$SPECSTORY_PATH"
    printf 'claude_session_uuid\t%s\n' "$CLAUDE_UUID"
    printf 'claude_jsonl_path\t%s\n' "$CLAUDE_JSONL"
    for candidate in "${CANDIDATES[@]:-}"; do
      [ -n "$candidate" ] && printf 'candidate\t%s\n' "$candidate"
    done
  fi
}

fail_result() {
  STATUS="$1"
  CONFIDENCE="none"
  local message="$2" rc="$3" candidate
  log "error: $message"
  if [ "${#CANDIDATES[@]}" -gt 0 ]; then
    log "candidates:"
    for candidate in "${CANDIDATES[@]}"; do
      log "  $candidate"
    done
  fi
  emit_result
  exit "$rc"
}

if ! git rev-parse --show-toplevel >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  fail_result "error" "not inside a git repository" 2
fi
REPO_ROOT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
SPECSTORY_DIR="$REPO_ROOT/.specstory/history"

case "$REPO_ROOT" in
  *$'\n'*|*$'\t'*|*$'\r'*) fail_result "mismatch" "git root contains an unsupported tab, carriage return, or newline" 5 ;;
esac

cwd_slug() {
  printf '%s' "$REPO_ROOT" | sed 's|[^A-Za-z0-9]|-|g'
}

canonical_existing_file() {
  local input="$1" absolute parent base
  case "$input" in
    /*) absolute="$input" ;;
    *)  absolute="$REPO_ROOT/$input" ;;
  esac
  [ -f "$absolute" ] || return 1
  parent="$(cd "$(dirname "$absolute")" 2>/dev/null && pwd -P)" || return 1
  base="$(basename "$absolute")"
  printf '%s/%s' "$parent" "$base"
}

specstory_header_uuid() {
  sed -n -E 's/^<!-- Claude Code Session ([0-9A-Fa-f]{8}-[0-9A-Fa-f]{4}-[0-9A-Fa-f]{4}-[0-9A-Fa-f]{4}-[0-9A-Fa-f]{12}) \([^)]*\) -->$/\1/p' "$1" \
    | head -n 1
}

validate_specstory_path() {
  local path="$1" uuid
  case "$path" in
    "$SPECSTORY_DIR"/*.md) ;;
    *) return 2 ;;
  esac
  uuid="$(specstory_header_uuid "$path")"
  [ -n "$uuid" ] || return 3
  printf '%s' "$uuid"
}

validate_claude_jsonl() {
  local path="$1" uuid="$2"
  command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 || return 3
  python3 - "$path" "$uuid" "$REPO_ROOT" <<'PY'
import json
import sys

path, expected_session, expected_cwd = sys.argv[1:]
matched = False
saw_identity = False
try:
    with open(path, encoding="utf-8") as stream:
        for line in stream:
            try:
                value = json.loads(line)
            except json.JSONDecodeError:
                # A live writer can leave one incomplete trailing record. Identity
                # still has to be proven by another complete JSON object.
                continue
            if not isinstance(value, dict):
                continue
            if "sessionId" in value or "cwd" in value:
                saw_identity = True
            if value.get("sessionId") == expected_session and value.get("cwd") == expected_cwd:
                matched = True
                break
except (OSError, UnicodeError):
    sys.exit(2)

if matched:
    sys.exit(0)
sys.exit(1 if saw_identity else 2)
PY
}

newest_file() {
  local dir="$1" glob="$2" newest="" file
  [ -d "$dir" ] || { printf ''; return 0; }
  while IFS= read -r -d '' file; do
    if [ -z "$newest" ] || [ "$file" -nt "$newest" ]; then
      newest="$file"
    fi
  done < <(find "$dir" -maxdepth 1 -type f -name "$glob" -print0 2>/dev/null)
  printf '%s' "$newest"
}

resolve_exact_specstory() {
  local selected_uuid="" file uuid
  if [ -n "$SPECSTORY_INPUT" ]; then
    if ! SPECSTORY_PATH="$(canonical_existing_file "$SPECSTORY_INPUT")"; then
      CANDIDATES+=("$SPECSTORY_INPUT")
      fail_result "not_found" "SpecStory path does not exist as a file: $SPECSTORY_INPUT" 3
    fi
    case "$SPECSTORY_PATH" in
      *$'\n'*|*$'\t'*|*$'\r'*)
        CANDIDATES+=("$SPECSTORY_PATH")
        fail_result "mismatch" "SpecStory path contains an unsupported tab, carriage return, or newline" 5 ;;
    esac
    CANDIDATES+=("$SPECSTORY_PATH")
    if ! selected_uuid="$(validate_specstory_path "$SPECSTORY_PATH")"; then
      fail_result "mismatch" "--specstory-path must be a Markdown file directly under the git root's .specstory/history/ with an exact Claude Code Session UUID header" 5
    fi
    if [ -n "$SESSION_ID" ] && [ "$selected_uuid" != "$SESSION_ID" ]; then
      fail_result "mismatch" "SpecStory header UUID '$selected_uuid' does not equal --session-id '$SESSION_ID'" 5
    fi
    CLAUDE_UUID="$selected_uuid"
    CANDIDATES=()
    return 0
  fi

  [ -d "$SPECSTORY_DIR" ] || fail_result "not_found" "no .specstory/history directory under git root $REPO_ROOT" 3
  while IFS= read -r -d '' file; do
    uuid="$(specstory_header_uuid "$file")"
    [ "$uuid" = "$SESSION_ID" ] && CANDIDATES+=("$file")
  done < <(find "$SPECSTORY_DIR" -maxdepth 1 -type f -name '*.md' -print0 2>/dev/null)

  case "${#CANDIDATES[@]}" in
    0) fail_result "not_found" "no SpecStory transcript has exact Claude Code Session UUID '$SESSION_ID' under $SPECSTORY_DIR" 3 ;;
    1) SPECSTORY_PATH="${CANDIDATES[0]}"; CANDIDATES=() ;;
    *) fail_result "ambiguous" "multiple SpecStory transcripts have session UUID '$SESSION_ID'; retry with --specstory-path" 4 ;;
  esac
}

resolve_exact_claude() {
  local project_dir candidate validation_rc=0
  [ -n "$CLAUDE_UUID" ] || fail_result "mismatch" "no Claude session UUID could be derived from the exact selector" 5
  project_dir="$HOME/.claude/projects/$(cwd_slug)"
  candidate="$project_dir/$CLAUDE_UUID.jsonl"
  if [ ! -f "$candidate" ]; then
    CANDIDATES+=("$candidate")
    fail_result "not_found" "exact Claude JSONL not found for checkout '$REPO_ROOT' and session '$CLAUDE_UUID'" 3
  fi
  CLAUDE_JSONL="$candidate"
  CANDIDATES+=("$candidate")
  validate_claude_jsonl "$candidate" "$CLAUDE_UUID" || validation_rc=$?
  case "$validation_rc" in
    0) CANDIDATES=() ;;
    3) fail_result "mismatch" "python3 is required to validate exact Claude JSONL identity" 5 ;;
    *) fail_result "mismatch" "Claude JSONL did not contain an exact sessionId/cwd record for '$CLAUDE_UUID' and '$REPO_ROOT'" 5 ;;
  esac
}

resolve_newest() {
  local project_dir header_uuid
  if [ "$FORMAT" = "both" ] || [ "$FORMAT" = "specstory" ]; then
    SPECSTORY_PATH="$(newest_file "$SPECSTORY_DIR" '*.md')"
    [ -n "$SPECSTORY_PATH" ] || fail_result "not_found" "no .specstory/history/*.md under git root $REPO_ROOT" 3
    header_uuid="$(specstory_header_uuid "$SPECSTORY_PATH")"
    [ -n "$header_uuid" ] && CLAUDE_UUID="$header_uuid"
  fi
  if [ "$FORMAT" = "both" ] || [ "$FORMAT" = "claude" ]; then
    project_dir="$HOME/.claude/projects/$(cwd_slug)"
    CLAUDE_JSONL="$(newest_file "$project_dir" '*.jsonl')"
    [ -n "$CLAUDE_JSONL" ] || fail_result "not_found" "no Claude JSONL under $project_dir" 3
    CLAUDE_UUID="$(basename "$CLAUDE_JSONL" .jsonl)"
  fi
}

if [ "$USE_NEWEST" = "1" ]; then
  resolve_newest
  STATUS="resolved"
  CONFIDENCE="heuristic"
else
  if [ "$FORMAT" = "both" ] || [ "$FORMAT" = "specstory" ]; then
    resolve_exact_specstory
  elif [ -n "$SPECSTORY_INPUT" ]; then
    # A path can supply the UUID even when only Claude output was requested.
    selected_path="$(canonical_existing_file "$SPECSTORY_INPUT" 2>/dev/null || true)"
    [ -n "$selected_path" ] || {
      CANDIDATES+=("$SPECSTORY_INPUT")
      fail_result "not_found" "SpecStory path does not exist as a file: $SPECSTORY_INPUT" 3
    }
    CANDIDATES+=("$selected_path")
    selected_uuid="$(validate_specstory_path "$selected_path" 2>/dev/null || true)"
    [ -n "$selected_uuid" ] || fail_result "mismatch" "--specstory-path does not have an exact Claude Code Session UUID header" 5
    if [ -n "$SESSION_ID" ] && [ "$selected_uuid" != "$SESSION_ID" ]; then
      fail_result "mismatch" "SpecStory header UUID '$selected_uuid' does not equal --session-id '$SESSION_ID'" 5
    fi
    CLAUDE_UUID="$selected_uuid"
    CANDIDATES=()
  fi
  if [ "$FORMAT" = "both" ] || [ "$FORMAT" = "claude" ]; then
    resolve_exact_claude
  fi
  STATUS="resolved"
  CONFIDENCE="exact"
fi

emit_result

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# stage-agent-artifacts.sh — git-add validated agent artifacts before a commit.
#
# Exact session-only mode is fail-closed. The default broad mode preserves the
# historical branch-wide behavior for callers that intentionally want it.
# Bash 3.2 compatible (stock macOS).

set -euo pipefail

DEFAULT_DIRS_FILE="$SKILL_DIR/assets/artifact-dirs.txt"

Usage: stage-agent-artifacts.sh [OPTIONS]

Stage agent artifacts for the next commit. Must run inside a git repository.
The default is broad branch-wide compatibility mode: every dirty Markdown file
under the configured artifact directories. Use --session-only for exact mode.

Exact session-only options:
  --session-only          Stage only one exact transcript plus an explicit plan.
  --session-id UUID       Exact Claude Code session UUID.
  --specstory-path PATH   Exact .specstory/history/*.md path (relative paths are
                          resolved from the git root). May accompany UUID.
  --no-specstory          Intentionally omit rendered SpecStory history. Requires
                          --session-id so the raw Claude JSONL can still be proved.
  --plan PATH             Stage this exact in-repo Markdown plan.
  --no-plan               Explicitly state that this session has no plan.

Broad-mode options:
  --include-all-plans     Re-add already-staged modified artifact files instead
                          of considering only unstaged/untracked files.
  --dirs-file PATH        Override artifact-dirs.txt.

Common options:
  --dry-run               Validate and print one proposed git-add set, but do not
                          change the index.
  --allow-empty           Allow artifact-only staging when there are no code
                          changes (default refuses accidental transcript-only work).
  --help, -h              Show this help and exit.

Exit codes:
  0  success, or no artifacts needed while code changes are present
  1  invalid arguments
  2  not inside a git repository
  3  no code changes and no dirty artifacts
  4  artifacts are dirty but code is clean (use --allow-empty)
  5  exact selector/path validation failed; index is unchanged
EOF

warn() { printf 'warn: %s\n' "$*" >&2; }

    --plan=*) PLAN_INPUT="${1#--plan=}"; shift ;;
    --no-plan) NO_PLAN=1; shift ;;
    --include-all-plans) INCLUDE_ALL_PLANS=1; shift ;;
    --dirs-file)

    --dirs-file=*) DIRS_FILE="${1#--dirs-file=}"; shift ;;
    --dry-run) DRY_RUN=1; shift ;;
    --allow-empty) ALLOW_EMPTY=1; shift ;;
    --help|-h) usage; exit 0 ;;
    -*) die "unknown flag: $1 (try --help)" 1 ;;
    *)  die "unexpected positional arg: $1 (try --help)" 1 ;;
  esac
done

  line="$(printf '%s' "$line" | sed 's/^[[:space:]]*//;s/[[:space:]]*$//')"

  [ -f "$absolute" ] || return 1
  [ ! -L "$absolute" ] || return 2
  parent="$(cd "$(dirname "$absolute")" 2>/dev/null && pwd -P)" || return 1
  base="$(basename "$absolute")"
  printf '%s/%s' "$parent" "$base"
}

repo_relative_path() {
  local absolute="$1"
  case "$absolute" in
    "$REPO_ROOT"/*) printf '%s' "${absolute#"$REPO_ROOT"/}" ;;
    *) return 1 ;;
  esac
}

validate_candidate_path() {
  local path="$1" dir matched=0
  case "$path" in
    /*|../*|*/../*|*/..|.|..|*$'\n'*|*$'\t'*|*$'\r'*)
      die "artifact path is not a safe repo-relative path: $path" 5 ;;
    *.md) ;;

  fi
}

append_unique_candidate() {
  local path="$1" existing
  for existing in "${CANDIDATES[@]:-}"; do
    [ "$existing" = "$path" ] && return 0
  done
  CANDIDATES+=("$path")
}

list_dirty_artifacts() {
  local dir path git_status entry
  for dir in "${ARTIFACT_DIRS[@]}"; do

run_exact_selector() {
  local selector_output selector_rc=0

  [ -n "$SESSION_ID" ] && set -- "$@" --session-id "$SESSION_ID"
  [ -n "$SPECSTORY_INPUT" ] && set -- "$@" --specstory-path "$SPECSTORY_INPUT"

  if [ "$selector_rc" != "0" ]; then
    printf '%s\n' "$selector_output" >&2
    die "exact session selector failed (find-session exit $selector_rc); index unchanged" 5
  fi
  printf '%s' "$selector_output"
}

CANDIDATES=()

if [ "$SESSION_ONLY" = "1" ]; then
  if [ "$NO_SPECSTORY" = "1" ]; then
    # Prove that the explicitly named raw Claude session belongs to this checkout.
    selector_output="$(run_exact_selector claude)"
  else
    # Prove both rendered and raw artifacts describe the same checkout/session.
    selector_output="$(run_exact_selector both)"
    specstory_absolute="$(printf '%s\n' "$selector_output" | awk -F '\t' '$1=="specstory_path" {print $2; exit}')"
    [ -n "$specstory_absolute" ] || die "exact selector returned no SpecStory path; index unchanged" 5
    if ! specstory_relative="$(repo_relative_path "$specstory_absolute")"; then
      die "exact selector returned a transcript outside the git root: $specstory_absolute" 5
    fi
    append_unique_candidate "$specstory_relative"
  fi

  if [ -n "$PLAN_INPUT" ]; then
    plan_rc=0
    plan_absolute="$(canonical_existing_file "$PLAN_INPUT")" || plan_rc=$?
    case "$plan_rc" in
      0) ;;
      2) die "--plan must not be a symlink: $PLAN_INPUT; index unchanged" 5 ;;
      *) die "--plan does not exist as a regular file: $PLAN_INPUT; index unchanged" 5 ;;
    esac
    if ! plan_relative="$(repo_relative_path "$plan_absolute")"; then
      die "--plan is outside the git root: $plan_absolute; index unchanged" 5
    fi
    is_plan_path "$plan_relative" || die "--plan must be under a supported in-repo plan directory: $plan_relative" 5
    append_unique_candidate "$plan_relative"
  fi
else
  while IFS= read -r -d '' artifact; do
    append_unique_candidate "$artifact"
  done < <(list_dirty_artifacts)
fi

# Complete path validation before any index mutation.
for artifact in "${CANDIDATES[@]:-}"; do
  [ -n "$artifact" ] || continue
  validate_candidate_path "$artifact"
done

if [ "${#CANDIDATES[@]}" -eq 0 ]; then
  if has_code_changes; then
    log "No agent artifacts to stage; code changes present — nothing to do."
    exit 0
  fi
  log "Nothing to stage: no code changes and no dirty artifacts."
  exit 3
fi

if [ "$ALLOW_EMPTY" = "0" ] && ! has_code_changes; then
  log "Refusing: artifacts are dirty but no code changes are present."
  log "         A transcript/plan commit without a feature diff is usually wrong."
  log "         Re-run with --allow-empty if this artifact-only change is intentional."
  exit 4
fi

if [ "$DRY_RUN" = "1" ]; then
  for artifact in "${CANDIDATES[@]}"; do
    printf '[dry-run] would git add: %s\n' "$artifact"
  done
  log "${#CANDIDATES[@]} artifact(s) validated; index unchanged."
  exit 0
fi

# One git process updates the index only after every selector/path check passed.
git add -- "${CANDIDATES[@]}"
for artifact in "${CANDIDATES[@]}"; do
  printf 'staged: %s\n' "$artifact"
done
log "${#CANDIDATES[@]} artifact(s) staged atomically."

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Regression tests for scripts/find-session.sh.
# Bash 3.2 compatible (stock macOS).

set -u

TESTS_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
SKILL_DIR="$(cd "$TESTS_DIR/.." && pwd)"
SCRIPT="$SKILL_DIR/scripts/find-session.sh"
BASE="$(mktemp -d /tmp/test-find-session.XXXXXX)"
FAKE_HOME="$BASE/home"
PASS_COUNT=0
FAIL_COUNT=0
LAST_RC=0
LAST_OUT=""
LAST_ERR=""

trap 'rm -rf "$BASE"' EXIT

pass() { PASS_COUNT=$((PASS_COUNT + 1)); printf '  PASS %s\n' "$1"; }
fail() { FAIL_COUNT=$((FAIL_COUNT + 1)); printf '  FAIL %s\n' "$1"; }

assert_true() {
  local name="$1"
  shift
  if "$@"; then pass "$name"; else fail "$name"; fi
}

make_repo() {
  local name="$1" repo="$BASE/$1"
  mkdir -p "$repo"
  git -C "$repo" init -q -b main
  git -C "$repo" -c user.name=test -c user.email=test@example.com \
    commit -q --allow-empty -m init
  printf '%s' "$repo"
}

project_slug() {
  printf '%s' "$1" | sed 's|[^A-Za-z0-9]|-|g'
}

write_jsonl() {
  local repo="$1" uuid="$2" recorded_cwd="${3:-$1}" path
  path="$FAKE_HOME/.claude/projects/$(project_slug "$repo")/$uuid.jsonl"
  mkdir -p "$(dirname "$path")"
  python3 - "$path" "$uuid" "$recorded_cwd" <<'PY'
import json
import sys

path, session_id, cwd = sys.argv[1:]
with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
    stream.write(json.dumps({"type": "user", "sessionId": session_id, "cwd": cwd}) + "\n")
PY
  printf '%s' "$path"
}

write_transcript() {
  local repo="$1" name="$2" uuid="$3" path="$repo/.specstory/history/$name"
  mkdir -p "$(dirname "$path")"
  printf '%s\n' \
    '<!-- Generated by SpecStory, Markdown v2.1.0 -->' \
    "<!-- Claude Code Session $uuid (2026-08-28 08:00:00Z) -->" \
    '_**Agent (Claude Opus 5 2026-08-28 08:00:01Z)**_' \
    > "$path"
  printf '%s' "$path"
}

run_find() {
  local cwd="$1"
  shift
  local out="$BASE/out" err="$BASE/err"
  (cd "$cwd" && HOME="$FAKE_HOME" bash "$SCRIPT" "$@") >"$out" 2>"$err"
  LAST_RC=$?
  LAST_OUT="$(<"$out")"
  LAST_ERR="$(<"$err")"
}

contains() { printf '%s\n' "$1" | grep -Fq -- "$2"; }
count_candidates() { printf '%s\n' "$1" | grep -c '^candidate[[:space:]]'; }

UUID_A="11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"
UUID_B="22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222"
UUID_C="33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333"

printf '== find-session exact selectors ==\n'

# Same checkout, different branches: artifacts remain path-scoped. Make branch
# A's files newer so --newest leaks across the branch switch, then prove the
# branch-B UUID still resolves exactly.
repo="$(make_repo 'same checkout with spaces')"
git -C "$repo" checkout -q -b feature-a
transcript_a="$(write_transcript "$repo" 'feature-a.md' "$UUID_A")"
jsonl_a="$(write_jsonl "$repo" "$UUID_A")"
git -C "$repo" checkout -q -b feature-b
transcript_b="$(write_transcript "$repo" 'feature-b.md' "$UUID_B")"
jsonl_b="$(write_jsonl "$repo" "$UUID_B")"
sleep 1
touch "$transcript_a" "$jsonl_a"
run_find "$repo" --session-id "$UUID_B"
if [ "$LAST_RC" = "0" ] && contains "$LAST_OUT" $'confidence\texact' && \
   contains "$LAST_OUT" "specstory_path${IFS:0:1}$transcript_b" && \
   contains "$LAST_OUT" "claude_jsonl_path${IFS:0:1}$jsonl_b"; then
  pass "exact UUID prevents same-checkout branch mtime leakage"
else
  fail "exact UUID prevents same-checkout branch mtime leakage"
fi
run_find "$repo" --newest
if [ "$LAST_RC" = "0" ] && contains "$LAST_OUT" $'confidence\theuristic' && \
   contains "$LAST_OUT" "$transcript_a" && contains "$LAST_OUT" "$jsonl_a"; then
  pass "newest compatibility mode remains explicit and heuristic"
else
  fail "newest compatibility mode remains explicit and heuristic"
fi

# Duplicate rendered aliases for one UUID must fail until a path disambiguates.
repo_dup="$(make_repo 'duplicate aliases')"
alias_one="$(write_transcript "$repo_dup" 'alias one.md' "$UUID_C")"
alias_two="$(write_transcript "$repo_dup" 'alias two.md' "$UUID_C")"
write_jsonl "$repo_dup" "$UUID_C" >/dev/null
run_find "$repo_dup" --session-id "$UUID_C"
if [ "$LAST_RC" = "4" ] && contains "$LAST_OUT" $'status\tambiguous' && \
   [ "$(count_candidates "$LAST_OUT")" = "2" ] && contains "$LAST_ERR" 'retry with --specstory-path'; then
  pass "duplicate UUID reports both candidates and exits 4"
else
  fail "duplicate UUID reports both candidates and exits 4"
fi
mkdir -p "$repo_dup/nested/subdir"
run_find "$repo_dup/nested/subdir" --specstory-path '.specstory/history/alias two.md' --json
if [ "$LAST_RC" = "0" ] && contains "$LAST_OUT" '"status":"resolved"' && \
   contains "$LAST_OUT" '"confidence":"exact"' && contains "$LAST_OUT" "$alias_two"; then
  pass "git-root-relative spaced path resolves from a subdirectory"
else
  fail "git-root-relative spaced path resolves from a subdirectory"
fi

# A path outside the checkout can have a plausible header but is never accepted.
outside="$BASE/outside transcript.md"
printf '%s\n' "<!-- Claude Code Session $UUID_C (2026-08-28 08:00:00Z) -->" > "$outside"
run_find "$repo_dup/nested" --specstory-path "$outside" --format specstory
if [ "$LAST_RC" = "5" ] && contains "$LAST_OUT" $'status\tmismatch' && contains "$LAST_OUT" "$outside"; then
  pass "outside SpecStory path fails closed with candidate output"
else
  fail "outside SpecStory path fails closed with candidate output"
fi

# Two worktrees get distinct repo roots, SpecStory directories, and Claude
# slugs even when the same UUID is present in both.
repo_wt="$(make_repo 'primary worktree')"
worktree="$BASE/secondary worktree"
git -C "$repo_wt" worktree add -q -b secondary "$worktree"
wt_one_transcript="$(write_transcript "$repo_wt" 'same-session.md' "$UUID_A")"
wt_two_transcript="$(write_transcript "$worktree" 'same-session.md' "$UUID_A")"
wt_one_jsonl="$(write_jsonl "$repo_wt" "$UUID_A")"
wt_two_jsonl="$(write_jsonl "$worktree" "$UUID_A")"
mkdir -p "$repo_wt/deep/path" "$worktree/deep/path"
run_find "$repo_wt/deep/path" --session-id "$UUID_A"
first_out="$LAST_OUT"; first_rc="$LAST_RC"
run_find "$worktree/deep/path" --session-id "$UUID_A"
second_out="$LAST_OUT"; second_rc="$LAST_RC"
if [ "$first_rc" = "0" ] && [ "$second_rc" = "0" ] && \
   contains "$first_out" "$wt_one_transcript" && contains "$first_out" "$wt_one_jsonl" && \
   contains "$second_out" "$wt_two_transcript" && contains "$second_out" "$wt_two_jsonl" && \
   ! contains "$first_out" "$wt_two_transcript" && ! contains "$second_out" "$wt_one_transcript"; then
  pass "two worktrees remain checkout-path isolated from subdirectories"
else
  fail "two worktrees remain checkout-path isolated from subdirectories"
fi

# A correctly named raw file with the wrong embedded cwd is a mismatch, not a hit.
repo_bad="$(make_repo 'json identity')"
write_transcript "$repo_bad" 'session.md' "$UUID_B" >/dev/null
bad_jsonl="$(write_jsonl "$repo_bad" "$UUID_B" "$repo_dup")"
run_find "$repo_bad" --session-id "$UUID_B"
if [ "$LAST_RC" = "5" ] && contains "$LAST_OUT" $'status\tmismatch' && contains "$LAST_OUT" "$bad_jsonl"; then
  pass "Claude JSONL requires exact embedded sessionId and git-root cwd"
else
  fail "Claude JSONL requires exact embedded sessionId and git-root cwd"
fi

run_find "$repo" --format both
if [ "$LAST_RC" = "1" ]; then pass "no selector is an argument error"
else fail "no selector is an argument error (got $LAST_RC)"; fi

printf 'pass: %d\nfail: %d\n' "$PASS_COUNT" "$FAIL_COUNT"
[ "$FAIL_COUNT" = "0" ]

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Regression tests for scripts/stage-agent-artifacts.sh and the installed hook.
# Bash 3.2 compatible (stock macOS).

set -u

TESTS_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
SKILL_DIR="$(cd "$TESTS_DIR/.." && pwd)"
STAGE="$SKILL_DIR/scripts/stage-agent-artifacts.sh"
METADATA="$SKILL_DIR/scripts/agent-commit-metadata.sh"
BOOTSTRAP="$SKILL_DIR/scripts/bootstrap-project.sh"
BASE="$(mktemp -d /tmp/test-stage-agent.XXXXXX)"
BASE="$(cd "$BASE" && pwd -P)"
FAKE_HOME="$BASE/home"
PASS_COUNT=0
FAIL_COUNT=0
LAST_RC=0
LAST_OUT=""
LAST_ERR=""

trap 'rm -rf "$BASE"' EXIT

pass() { PASS_COUNT=$((PASS_COUNT + 1)); printf '  PASS %s\n' "$1"; }
fail() { FAIL_COUNT=$((FAIL_COUNT + 1)); printf '  FAIL %s\n' "$1"; }
contains() { printf '%s\n' "$1" | grep -Fq -- "$2"; }

make_repo() {
  local name="$1" repo="$BASE/$1"
  mkdir -p "$repo"
  git -C "$repo" init -q -b main
  printf '%s\n' base > "$repo/feature.txt"
  git -C "$repo" add feature.txt
  git -C "$repo" -c user.name=test -c user.email=test@example.com commit -q -m init
  printf '%s' "$repo"
}

project_slug() {
  printf '%s' "$1" | sed 's|[^A-Za-z0-9]|-|g'
}

write_jsonl() {
  local repo="$1" uuid="$2" path
  path="$FAKE_HOME/.claude/projects/$(project_slug "$repo")/$uuid.jsonl"
  mkdir -p "$(dirname "$path")"
  python3 - "$path" "$uuid" "$repo" <<'PY'
import json
import sys

path, session_id, cwd = sys.argv[1:]
with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
    stream.write(json.dumps({"type": "user", "sessionId": session_id, "cwd": cwd}) + "\n")
PY
}

write_transcript() {
  local repo="$1" name="$2" uuid="$3" path
  path="$repo/.specstory/history/$name"
  mkdir -p "$(dirname "$path")"
  printf '%s\n' \
    '<!-- Generated by SpecStory, Markdown v2.1.0 -->' \
    "<!-- Claude Code Session $uuid (2026-08-28 08:00:00Z) -->" \
    '_**Agent (Claude Opus 5 2026-08-28 08:00:01Z)**_' \
    > "$path"
  printf '%s' "$path"
}

write_plan() {
  local repo="$1" name="$2" path="$repo/.claude/plans/$name"
  mkdir -p "$(dirname "$path")"
  printf '# Exact plan\n' > "$path"
  printf '%s' "$path"
}

run_stage() {
  local cwd="$1"
  shift
  local out="$BASE/stage-out" err="$BASE/stage-err"
  (cd "$cwd" && HOME="$FAKE_HOME" bash "$STAGE" "$@") >"$out" 2>"$err"
  LAST_RC=$?
  LAST_OUT="$(<"$out")"
  LAST_ERR="$(<"$err")"
}

staged_names() { git -C "$1" diff --cached --name-only; }
staged_count() { staged_names "$1" | grep -c .; }

UUID_A="aaaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa"
UUID_B="bbbbbbbb-bbbb-4bbb-8bbb-bbbbbbbbbbbb"
UUID_C="cccccccc-cccc-4ccc-8ccc-cccccccccccc"

printf '== stage-agent-artifacts exact transaction ==\n'

# Exact session + explicit plan stages only the selected pair. Unrelated dirty
# artifacts remain unstaged, and metadata sees only the exact staged artifacts.
repo="$(make_repo 'exact paths with spaces')"
printf '%s\n' changed >> "$repo/feature.txt"
transcript="$(write_transcript "$repo" 'selected session.md' "$UUID_A")"
write_transcript "$repo" 'unrelated session.md' "$UUID_B" >/dev/null
plan="$(write_plan "$repo" 'selected plan.md')"
write_plan "$repo" 'unrelated plan.md' >/dev/null
write_jsonl "$repo" "$UUID_A"
mkdir -p "$repo/nested/path"
run_stage "$repo/nested/path" --session-only --session-id "$UUID_A" \
  --specstory-path '.specstory/history/selected session.md' \
  --plan '.claude/plans/selected plan.md'
names="$(staged_names "$repo")"
if [ "$LAST_RC" = "0" ] && [ "$(staged_count "$repo")" = "2" ] && \
   contains "$names" '.specstory/history/selected session.md' && \
   contains "$names" '.claude/plans/selected plan.md' && \
   ! contains "$names" 'unrelated'; then
  pass "exact session stages only selected spaced transcript and plan"
else
  fail "exact session stages only selected spaced transcript and plan"
fi
metadata="$(cd "$repo" && bash "$METADATA" 2>/dev/null)"
if contains "$metadata" 'AI-Assisted-By: Claude Code (Claude Opus 5)' && \
   contains "$metadata" 'Agent-Transcript: .specstory/history/selected session.md' && \
   contains "$metadata" 'Agent-Plan: .claude/plans/selected plan.md' && \
   ! contains "$metadata" 'unrelated'; then
  pass "metadata trailers reflect only exact staged artifacts"
else
  fail "metadata trailers reflect only exact staged artifacts"
fi
[ -f "$transcript" ] && [ -f "$plan" ] || fail "exact fixture files remain present"

# --no-plan is explicit and stages only the exact transcript.
repo_no_plan="$(make_repo 'explicit no plan')"
printf '%s\n' changed >> "$repo_no_plan/feature.txt"
write_transcript "$repo_no_plan" 'session.md' "$UUID_B" >/dev/null
write_jsonl "$repo_no_plan" "$UUID_B"
run_stage "$repo_no_plan" --session-only --session-id "$UUID_B" --no-plan
names="$(staged_names "$repo_no_plan")"
if [ "$LAST_RC" = "0" ] && [ "$(staged_count "$repo_no_plan")" = "1" ] && \
   contains "$names" '.specstory/history/session.md'; then
  pass "explicit --no-plan stages only exact transcript"
else
  fail "explicit --no-plan stages only exact transcript"
fi

# Missing plan policy is a usage failure and leaves the index untouched.
repo_missing="$(make_repo 'missing plan policy')"
printf '%s\n' changed >> "$repo_missing/feature.txt"
write_transcript "$repo_missing" 'session.md' "$UUID_C" >/dev/null
write_jsonl "$repo_missing" "$UUID_C"
before_tree="$(git -C "$repo_missing" write-tree)"
run_stage "$repo_missing" --session-only --session-id "$UUID_C"
after_tree="$(git -C "$repo_missing" write-tree)"
if [ "$LAST_RC" = "1" ] && [ "$before_tree" = "$after_tree" ]; then
  pass "missing --plan/--no-plan fails before index mutation"
else
  fail "missing --plan/--no-plan fails before index mutation"
fi

# --no-specstory still proves the exact raw session and stages no artifact when
# --no-plan is also explicit.
repo_raw="$(make_repo 'raw session only')"
printf '%s\n' changed >> "$repo_raw/feature.txt"
write_transcript "$repo_raw" 'left dirty.md' "$UUID_A" >/dev/null
write_jsonl "$repo_raw" "$UUID_A"
run_stage "$repo_raw" --session-only --session-id "$UUID_A" --no-specstory --no-plan
if [ "$LAST_RC" = "0" ] && [ "$(staged_count "$repo_raw")" = "0" ] && \
   contains "$LAST_ERR" 'No agent artifacts to stage'; then
  pass "explicit --no-specstory/--no-plan validates raw identity without staging"
else
  fail "explicit --no-specstory/--no-plan validates raw identity without staging"
fi

# Duplicate UUID is a selector failure. A pre-existing staged code change must
# remain byte-for-byte identical in the index.
repo_atomic="$(make_repo 'atomic selector failure')"
printf '%s\n' staged-change >> "$repo_atomic/feature.txt"
git -C "$repo_atomic" add feature.txt
write_transcript "$repo_atomic" 'alias one.md' "$UUID_B" >/dev/null
write_transcript "$repo_atomic" 'alias two.md' "$UUID_B" >/dev/null
write_plan "$repo_atomic" 'plan.md' >/dev/null
write_jsonl "$repo_atomic" "$UUID_B"
before_tree="$(git -C "$repo_atomic" write-tree)"
run_stage "$repo_atomic" --session-only --session-id "$UUID_B" --plan '.claude/plans/plan.md'
after_tree="$(git -C "$repo_atomic" write-tree)"
if [ "$LAST_RC" = "5" ] && [ "$before_tree" = "$after_tree" ] && \
   contains "$LAST_ERR" $'status\tambiguous'; then
  pass "selector ambiguity maps to exit 5 with index unchanged"
else
  fail "selector ambiguity maps to exit 5 with index unchanged"
fi

# Even a real Markdown file is rejected as a plan when it lives outside the
# checkout; the already-staged code tree remains unchanged.
outside_plan="$BASE/outside plan.md"
printf '# Outside\n' > "$outside_plan"
run_stage "$repo_atomic" --session-only --session-id "$UUID_B" \
  --specstory-path '.specstory/history/alias one.md' --plan "$outside_plan"
if [ "$LAST_RC" = "5" ] && [ "$(git -C "$repo_atomic" write-tree)" = "$before_tree" ]; then
  pass "outside plan fails validation before atomic git add"
else
  fail "outside plan fails validation before atomic git add"
fi

# Historical broad mode remains available and stages every dirty Markdown
# artifact under configured directories without requiring exact headers.
repo_broad="$(make_repo 'broad compatibility')"
printf '%s\n' changed >> "$repo_broad/feature.txt"
mkdir -p "$repo_broad/.specstory/history" "$repo_broad/.claude/plans" "$repo_broad/.cursor/rules"
printf '# legacy\n' > "$repo_broad/.specstory/history/legacy.md"
printf '# plan\n' > "$repo_broad/.claude/plans/all.md"
printf '# rule\n' > "$repo_broad/.cursor/rules/rule.md"
run_stage "$repo_broad"
names="$(staged_names "$repo_broad")"
if [ "$LAST_RC" = "0" ] && [ "$(staged_count "$repo_broad")" = "3" ] && \
   contains "$names" '.specstory/history/legacy.md' && \
   contains "$names" '.claude/plans/all.md' && contains "$names" '.cursor/rules/rule.md'; then
  pass "broad branch-wide compatibility mode stages all dirty artifacts"
else
  fail "broad branch-wide compatibility mode stages all dirty artifacts"
fi

printf '\n== bootstrap exact hook ==\n'

# Install with a local no-op pre-commit executable so the test never downloads.
fake_bin="$BASE/bin"
mkdir -p "$fake_bin"
printf '%s\n' '#!/usr/bin/env sh' 'exit 0' > "$fake_bin/pre-commit"
chmod +x "$fake_bin/pre-commit"
repo_hook="$(make_repo 'hook behavior')"
bootstrap_out="$BASE/bootstrap-out"
bootstrap_err="$BASE/bootstrap-err"
(cd "$repo_hook" && HOME="$FAKE_HOME" PATH="$fake_bin:$PATH" \
  bash "$BOOTSTRAP" --install-hook) >"$bootstrap_out" 2>"$bootstrap_err"
bootstrap_rc=$?
hook_path="$(git -C "$repo_hook" rev-parse --git-path hooks/prepare-commit-msg)"
case "$hook_path" in /*) ;; *) hook_path="$repo_hook/$hook_path" ;; esac

before_tree="$(git -C "$repo_hook" write-tree)"
(cd "$repo_hook" && HOME="$FAKE_HOME" \
  AGENT_HISTORY_SESSION_ID= AGENT_HISTORY_SPECSTORY_PATH= \
  AGENT_HISTORY_PLAN= AGENT_HISTORY_NO_PLAN= AGENT_HISTORY_NO_SPECSTORY= \
  bash "$hook_path" message.txt) >"$BASE/hook-out" 2>"$BASE/hook-err"
hook_rc=$?
hook_err="$(<"$BASE/hook-err")"
if [ "$bootstrap_rc" = "0" ] && [ "$hook_rc" = "0" ] && \
   contains "$hook_err" 'skipping exact artifact staging' && \
   [ "$(git -C "$repo_hook" write-tree)" = "$before_tree" ]; then

else

fi

write_transcript "$repo_hook" 'hook session.md' "$UUID_C" >/dev/null
write_plan "$repo_hook" 'hook plan.md' >/dev/null
write_jsonl "$repo_hook" "$UUID_C"
# Identity without a plan policy is a real error and must not be swallowed.
index_before_error="$(git -C "$repo_hook" write-tree)"
(cd "$repo_hook" && HOME="$FAKE_HOME" AGENT_HISTORY_SESSION_ID="$UUID_C" \
  bash "$hook_path" message.txt) >/dev/null 2>"$BASE/hook-error"
hook_error_rc=$?
if [ "$hook_error_rc" = "1" ] && [ "$(git -C "$repo_hook" write-tree)" = "$index_before_error" ]; then
  pass "hook propagates missing plan-policy failure"
else

fi

(cd "$repo_hook" && HOME="$FAKE_HOME" AGENT_HISTORY_SESSION_ID="$UUID_C" \
  AGENT_HISTORY_SPECSTORY_PATH='.specstory/history/hook session.md' \
  AGENT_HISTORY_PLAN='.claude/plans/hook plan.md' \
  bash "$hook_path" message.txt) >/dev/null 2>"$BASE/hook-exact-err"
hook_exact_rc=$?
names="$(staged_names "$repo_hook")"
if [ "$hook_exact_rc" = "0" ] && contains "$names" '.specstory/history/hook session.md' && \
   contains "$names" '.claude/plans/hook plan.md'; then
  pass "hook exact-stages only explicit AGENT_HISTORY paths"
else
  fail "hook exact-stages only explicit AGENT_HISTORY paths"
fi

repo_global="$(make_repo 'global hooks path')"
git -C "$repo_global" config core.hooksPath .githooks
(cd "$repo_global" && HOME="$FAKE_HOME" PATH="$fake_bin:$PATH" \
  bash "$BOOTSTRAP" --install-hook --dry-run) >/dev/null 2>&1
global_rc=$?
if [ "$global_rc" = "6" ] && [ ! -e "$repo_global/.pre-commit-config.yaml" ]; then

else
  fail "global core.hooksPath refusal remains pre-write"
fi

printf 'pass: %d\nfail: %d\n' "$PASS_COUNT" "$FAIL_COUNT"
[ "$FAIL_COUNT" = "0" ]

````markdown
# Transcript & session discovery

How `find-session.sh` proves that one SpecStory Markdown file and one Claude Code
JSONL belong to the same session in the current git checkout.

## Exact by default

There is no reliable implicit "current session" pointer. Multiple sessions can
write under one checkout, and branch switches do not move those files. Therefore
`find-session.sh` requires at least one exact selector:

```bash
# UUID from Claude Code /status
bash scripts/find-session.sh \
  --session-id 01234567-89ab-4cde-8fab-0123456789ab

# Explicit rendered alias; relative paths resolve from the git root
bash scripts/find-session.sh \
  --specstory-path '.specstory/history/2026-08-28_08-00-00Z.md'

# Strongest form: both selectors must agree
bash scripts/find-session.sh \
  --session-id 01234567-89ab-4cde-8fab-0123456789ab \
  --specstory-path '.specstory/history/2026-08-28_08-00-00Z.md'
```

`--newest` is an explicit compatibility heuristic. It independently picks the
newest SpecStory Markdown and Claude JSONL by mtime and reports
`confidence=heuristic`; it does not prove that the two files belong together.
Never use it for exact staging or hooks.

## Git-root anchoring

The script starts with `git rev-parse --show-toplevel` and anchors all discovery
to that path. Calling it from `src/deep/subdir` is therefore equivalent to
calling it from the checkout root. A relative `--specstory-path` is also
interpreted from the git root, not the shell's current subdirectory.

Paths must be regular Markdown files directly under the checkout's
`.specstory/history/`. Outside paths and malformed headers fail closed.

## Claude Code session layout and proof

Claude Code stores raw sessions under:

```
~/.claude/projects/<checkout-slug>/<session-uuid>.jsonl
```

The slug is the absolute git-root path with **every non-alphanumeric character**
replaced by `-`, including dots, underscores, and spaces. For example,
`/home/user/.local/project one` becomes
`-home-user--local-project-one`. Rebuild it with
`sed 's/[^A-Za-z0-9]/-/g'`, not `tr '/' '-'`.

Exact resolution does not trust the filename alone. It parses complete JSONL
records and requires one object whose:

- `sessionId` exactly equals the selected UUID; and
- `cwd` exactly equals the current git root.

A live writer may leave one incomplete trailing JSON line; malformed lines are
ignored, but another complete record still has to prove both fields. A correctly
named file with another checkout's `cwd` exits as a mismatch.

## SpecStory layout, header, and aliases

SpecStory writes rendered output under:

```
<git-root>/.specstory/history/<rendered-name>.md
```

For Claude sessions, exact matching requires this whole header shape:

```markdown
<!-- Claude Code Session 01234567-89ab-4cde-8fab-0123456789ab (2026-08-28 08:00:00Z) -->
```

`--session-id` scans header UUIDs, not filenames or substring matches. One UUID
can have multiple rendered aliases. In that case the script returns
`status=ambiguous`, lists every candidate, exits 4, and requires an explicit
`--specstory-path` to disambiguate. When both selectors are supplied, the path's
header UUID must exactly equal `--session-id`.

To render one known raw session explicitly with SpecStory 2.10:

```bash
specstory sync claude -s 01234567-89ab-4cde-8fab-0123456789ab
```

If that creates another alias for a UUID already present, select the intended
path explicitly; do not infer from its timestamp.

## SpecStory 2.10 scoping: checkout path, not branch

Verified behavior in SpecStory 2.10:

- Rendered output discovery is scoped to the checkout path containing
  `.specstory/history/`, not to the checked-out branch name.
- Raw Claude session discovery is likewise scoped through the checkout path's
  Claude project slug, not its branch.
- Switching branches in one checkout therefore exposes the same session pool.
  Newest-file selection can pick a transcript produced on another branch.
- Two worktrees have different roots, SpecStory history directories, and Claude
  project slugs. Prefer **worktree first, wrapper/session second**.
- Run one SpecStory wrapper/session per change stream. If a stream moves, stop
  the old wrapper and start a new one in the target worktree.
- `EnterWorktree` changes the agent's working directory; it does **not** rebind a
  SpecStory watcher that was already running against another checkout.

This is why branch identity never appears in the exact selector contract. The
stable tuple is checkout root + session UUID + rendered path when needed.

## Structured output

TSV is the default and always starts with resolution metadata:

```text
status	resolved
confidence	exact
source	session-id+specstory-path
specstory_path	/absolute/checkout/.specstory/history/session.md
claude_session_uuid	01234567-89ab-4cde-8fab-0123456789ab
claude_jsonl_path	/absolute/home/.claude/projects/<slug>/<uuid>.jsonl
```

Ambiguous or invalid selections add repeated `candidate<TAB>path` rows. `--json`
emits the same fields plus a `candidates` array as one JSON object. Diagnostics
go to stderr; `--quiet` suppresses those diagnostics without hiding structured
stdout.

| Exit | Meaning |
|---:|---|
| 0 | Requested exact artifacts resolved, or explicit heuristic succeeded |
| 1 | Invalid/missing arguments |
| 2 | Not inside a git repository |
| 3 | Requested artifact not found |
| 4 | Exact UUID has multiple rendered candidates |
| 5 | Path, header, or JSONL identity mismatch |

These nonzero exits are intentional. Callers must not convert absence or
ambiguity into an empty "success" and then guess.

## Exact staging handoff

`stage-agent-artifacts.sh --session-only` calls this resolver before touching
the index. It requires exact identity plus exactly one of `--plan PATH` or
`--no-plan`; use `--no-specstory` only with `--session-id` when rendered output
is intentionally absent. Resolver failures map to staging exit 5 and leave the
index unchanged.

The staging script's no-selector invocation remains broad branch-wide
compatibility mode. It stages all dirty Markdown under configured artifact
directories and does not claim session identity.

## Cross-reference

- [`pre-commit-redaction-stack.md`](./pre-commit-redaction-stack.md) — how
  selected files are scanned and redacted at commit time.
- [`../scripts/find-session.sh`](../scripts/find-session.sh) — exact resolver.
- [`../scripts/stage-agent-artifacts.sh`](../scripts/stage-agent-artifacts.sh) —
  validation and one-shot index update.
